author: Craig Dewar
releaseNotes:
v3.3.22
- Stream Driver: Fixed apiGet() not checking rate limit state - GET requests now blocked when rate limited
- Stream Driver: Prevents API call bursts on reconnect that would re-trigger rate limiting
- Stream Driver: notifyParentReconnected() now skips device refresh when rate limited OR disconnected
- Stream Driver: HTTP 429 backoff increased to 1 hour (was 60 seconds) and won't override longer SSE-derived rate limits
- Stream Driver: Fixed disconnect event overwriting 'rate limited' status with 'disconnected' (hid rate limit from user)
- Stream Driver: Watchdog now shows rate limit expiry time and minutes remaining in logs
- Stream Driver: Watchdog auto-corrects connectionStatus if rate limited but showing 'disconnected'
- Stream Driver: Connection bounces (connect then immediate disconnect) no longer trigger device refresh
- Stream Driver: clearRateLimit now warns that server-side rate limits may still apply
- App: refreshAllDeviceStatus() checks stream driver rate limit before making API calls
- Fixes rate limit loop where users got permanently stuck in 24-hour rate limit cycles
- DO NOT click Initialize while rate limited - wait for the rate limit to fully expire first

v3.3.21
- Stream Driver: Fixed SSE stream not auto-recovering after connection loss
- Stream Driver: Watchdog now uses persistent cron schedule instead of fragile runIn() chain - survives hub restarts
- Stream Driver: Watchdog now auto-recovers from ALL non-connected states (was only checking when 'connected')
- Stream Driver: Fixed stale 'connecting' status blocking reconnection (60s timeout added)
- Stream Driver: Fixed processingDisconnect flag getting stuck, silently ignoring disconnect events
- Stream Driver: Reconnect attempt counter now resets so driver never permanently gives up
- App: Child device 'Initialize and Configure' now also reconnects broken SSE stream
- Dishwasher: Added Ambient Light (Emotion Light) support for Siemens dishwashers (SX878D26PE etc.)
- Dishwasher: New attributes: ambientLightEnabled, ambientLightBrightness, ambientLightColor
- Resolves issue where all appliance status updates stop after stream disconnect (reported ~March 9th)
- After updating, click Initialize on your Stream Driver to activate the new persistent watchdog

v3.3.20
- Dishwasher: Added waterForecast and energyForecast attributes (previously unhandled events)
- Dishwasher: Added remainingProgramTimeIsEstimated attribute
- Dishwasher: Formatted remaining time shows '~' prefix when appliance reports time as estimated (e.g. '~00:41')

v3.3.19
- Dishwasher: Fixed remainingProgramTime not updating during cycle
- Dishwasher: API doesn't send RemainingProgramTime SSE events until final minutes - now fetches active program via REST when cycle starts
- Dishwasher: Added remaining time estimation from elapsed time + progress% as fallback
- Dishwasher: Added isStateChange:true to remaining time updates to ensure Hubitat processes them
- Dishwasher: Added debug logging around remaining time updates for diagnostics

v3.3.18
- Stream Driver: Fixed keep-alive detection (bare 'data:' messages were silently dropped since day one)
- Stream Driver: API call counter resets now sync to Home Connect's own window via X-RateLimit-Remaining header
- Dishwasher: Local timer ticker updates elapsed/remaining time every 60s so dashboards stay current during mid-cycle API silences
- Dishwasher: Finished event now preserves final elapsed time, sets progress=100%, and immediately updates cyclePhase/friendlyStatus
- Dishwasher: Ready/Inactive now properly resets cyclePhase=Idle and friendlyStatus=Ready
- Dishwasher: SSE timing events reset ticker phase so API data always takes precedence

v3.3.16
- Stream Driver: Handle bare JSON lines in SSE messages (Hubitat may deliver data without data: prefix)
- Dishwasher: Fixed derived states (estimatedEndTime, cyclePhase, friendlyStatus, elapsedTime) not updating when operationState is null
- Dishwasher: Infers Run state from active timing values when operationState is missing (e.g. after driver update mid-cycle)
- Dishwasher: Deferred jsonState and derived state updates for SSE events to ensure values persist before reading
- Dishwasher: Seeds programStartTime from derived state when missing during active cycle

v3.3.15
- Stream Driver: Added verbose stream diagnostics toggle for debugging stale event issues
- Stream Driver: Tracks per-appliance last event times to identify which appliance stops receiving events
- Stream Driver: Watchdog now logs detailed health every 5 min when verbose diagnostics enabled
- Stream Driver: Added showStreamHealth command for on-demand diagnostics
- Stream Driver: Fixed watchdog not starting when driver code is updated on an active connection
- After updating, enable 'verbose stream diagnostics' in Stream Driver preferences to monitor event health

v3.3.13
- All drivers now auto-initialize when driver code is updated via HPM
- No longer need to manually click Initialize on each device after updating
- Stream Driver automatically reconnects SSE event stream after code update
- Appliance drivers automatically refresh status and available programs
- Dishwasher: Elapsed program time now calculated locally when appliance doesn't report it
- Stream Driver: Always refreshes device status on reconnect for complete state recovery

v3.3.12
- Stream Driver: Added watchdog to auto-recover silently dead SSE connections
- Stream Driver: If no data arrives for 3 minutes (KEEP-ALIVE comes every ~55s), forces reconnect
- Stream Driver: Fixes appliances stopping to receive real-time events until manual refresh
- Stream Driver: Added message buffer overflow protection
- Stream Driver: Fixed double-processing of SSE events
- Dishwasher: Fixed jsonState showing stale values after status refresh
- Dishwasher: Fixed z_parseActiveProgram not updating jsonState
- After updating, click Initialize on your Stream Driver to activate the watchdog

v3.3.11
- Fixed lastCommandStatus not updating on successful commands (was only showing failures)
- Thanks to user feedback for spotting this behavior!

v3.3.10
- FridgeFreezer: Added support for ChillerLeft, ChillerRight, and FlexCompartment doors
- FridgeFreezer: New contact attributes for all door types (chillerLeftContact, etc.)
- FridgeFreezer: Fixed aggregate contact to include all door types
- Thanks to user feedback for reporting the unhandled door events!

v3.3.9
- FridgeFreezer: Added individual contact attributes (fridgeContact, freezerContact, flexZoneContact)
- FridgeFreezer: Contact attributes use 'open'/'closed' for Rule Machine compatibility
- Allows triggering RM rules on specific compartment doors instead of just 'any door open'

v3.3.8
- Dishwasher: cyclePhase now shows 'Idle' when Ready (was incorrectly showing 'Prewash')
- Dishwasher: activeProgram clears to 'None' when cycle ends (improves automation reliability)
- Dishwasher: RinseAidNearlyEmpty/SaltNearlyEmpty now initialize to 'Off' (visible immediately)
- Dishwasher: Run Initialize to populate consumable attributes on existing installs
- App: Updated setup instructions for current Home Connect Developer Portal
- App: Added Default Home Connect Account for Testing requirement
- App: Added Redirect URI format example

v3.3.6
- Fixed devices not created on first install
- Oven: on/off now starts/stops programs instead of setting power
- Oven: Fixed program key lookup to use API-reported keys
- Oven: Added warnings when setting temp/duration without a program selected
- Hood: Fixed fan speed control for Option-based hoods
- Hood: Added FanControl compatibility (medium-low, medium-high, on)
- Hood: Light brightness 0 now turns off light
- Hood: Added grease filter alert handler
- Improved 409 error messages with user-friendly translations
- Added Actuator capability to all drivers
- Added clear error message when optional HPM driver is missing
